title: Queenstown NZ
body:
O.P.
I'm planning a 5 night stay in Queenstown and I'm wondering about the best location in town to stay. Which area is in close proximity to cafes and shops? Thanks

---- replies ----
[User #905785708 postsWaldaWhirlpool Enthusiast] Its a pretty small place, very walkable. I stayed in a cheap waterfront place opposite this park https://maps.app.goo.gl/Uxk86ska3Xo3rvK78
[User #3707861170 postsWillieredWhirlpool Enthusiast] The Whistler Holiday Apartments are centrally located if you want to have a kitchenette. You can walk to most things from there
[User #27088526 postsColonel FlaggWhirlpool Enthusiast] YHA Queenstown Lakefront –
a 5-10 minute walk along the lake to town, but was surprisingly good
Had our own private room / bathroom
Lake view room with balcony
[User #3269138271 postsAlpha8Self Funded RetireeWhirlpool Forums Addict] The Crowne Plaza is in a good location, with day tour coaches and boat cruises across the road at the Queenstown Visitor Centre (bookings can be made here). Has in-house restaurant and several other restaurants within walking distance, including a Thai restaurant, Indian Restaurant and a Chinese restaurant. Also within walking distance from the Shopping Mall and Skyline Queenstown.
https://queenstown.crowneplaza.com/
"Immerse yourself in the breathtaking beauty of the famous mountain and lake views that surround our Queenstown accommodation. Located in the centre of Queenstown, our hotel is conveniently positioned opposite the historic Steamer Wharf, providing easy access to lakeside dining, entertainment, and vibrant social scenes."
[User #5479452260 postsSeeMyVeste-Power Aura & X-TrailWhirlpool Forums Addict] Me and the family are planning trip to Queenstown in August, planning to stay 5 nights there and we're staying in an Airbnb.
Before that, we're going to fly into Christchurch on the Saturday, stay there for a couple of days there, we're going to hire a car from Christchurch, and road trip it from Christchurch to Queenstown, do about 3 stops along the way, stopping at Lake Tekapo, Lake Pukaki and if there is still some light, either Lake Hawea or Wanaka (either of them is fine).
Our planned activities are: - Skiing in Coronet - Skyline gondola and ride the Luge - full day trip to Glenorchy which includes stargazing - go Karting in the Highlands - Wine and beer tasting - Fox Glacier walk
After Queenstown, we plan to drive along the west coast back to Christchurch, we are going to stay one night in Franz Josef and do the walk to Callery Bridge.
[User #90105345 postsBit Of Dis'N  DatParticipant] SeeMyVest writes...
Me and the family are planning trip to Queenstown in August, planning to stay 5 nights there and we're staying in an Airbnb.
Having done this several times, I can vouch for your plans. You absolutely will love it. Queenstown is beautiful and the gondola is definitely worth it.
Enjoy ;-)
